rationale: Genome-wide HD CRISPR library A screen in RKO cells expressing the Kinprola PKA-activity recorder, labeled and sorted into high, basal and low recorder-signal bins in two independent screens (R2, R3), plus a day-0 library per screen. Each sample was sequenced on four lanes (one GSM each); prepare.R sums the lanes (technical re-reads, r = 0.98) and drops the unassigned columns. The paper's main volcano (Fig. 3b, limma on log-normalized counts) compares the high and low bins: knockouts that raise PKA activity are enriched in high, those that lower it in low. The primary analysis is high vs low; all three bins of both screens are fitted together so the basal bin contributes to the dispersion. design_vs_basal.json holds the paper's Extended Data high-vs-basal and low-vs-basal comparisons. All three bins of both screens are fitted together (~ bin, residual df 3). Bins correlate more across screens (high-high 0.95, low-low 0.95) than with other bins of the same screen (0.91-0.94), so there is no screen term. 159 NONTARG guides are the controls (the CONTROL_C_* cutting controls are not used as controls). Gene IDs are Ensembl.
